speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your chest pain and tell me if it feels like pressure, squeezing, or sharp stabbing pain. Have you noticed if the pain radiates to your arm, jaw, or back?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest and feels like a tight, squeezing pressure. It's radiating down to my left arm, and it doesn't seem to go away even though I've been resting. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic presentation of central squeezing pain radiating to the left arm with no relief at rest, immediate cardiac evaluation is critical. Please seek emergency care immediately; do not wait for this appointment to conclude.
